dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: This inn is great. The owner is friendly, and the service is good. We foreign merchants like staying here.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: But there is one problem: the noise insulation is bad.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: I could hear the buzz of conversation next door while lying in bed at night.

dialogues.speaker: Ruying
dialogues.text: And I don't know if the man and woman next door were speaking in a dialect or something... I could understand the words but not the meaning.
